cells.fields: id bigint identity; app varchar; name varchar; checksum char(64); applied_at timestamptz; operation_state jsonb
cells.invariants: Unique(app,name); immutable applied checksum; non-atomic operation checkpoints keyed by migration/operation. Created only by explicit migrate.

cells.fields: id UUID; identifier varchar; password_hash text nullable; active/staff/superuser bool; auth_version bigint; last_login nullable; created_at/updated_at UTC
cells.invariants: Unique normalized identifier under declared normalizer; default active=true, staff/superuser=false; auth_version starts 1 and increments on credential/grant change. Swappable user contract defined before initial migration.

cells.fields: group id UUID/name; permission id bigint/content_type_id/codename/name
cells.invariants: Unique group name; unique(content_type_id,codename); named view/add/change/delete generated per model plus explicit custom permissions.

cells.fields: Owner and target foreign-key pairs; created_at optional policy
cells.invariants: Composite unique pairs; FK cascade join rows only; auth-version invalidation after changes; never grant by client-submitted group ID without grant authority.

cells.fields: id bigint; app_label; model_name; schema_version; active bool
cells.invariants: Unique(app_label,model_name); stable identity; removal explicit stale-type cleanup with reference preview, not automatic drop.

cells.fields: key_digest char(64) PK; payload jsonb; version bigint; expires_at; created_at; updated_at; deleted_at/tombstone_until nullable
cells.invariants: Digest of random bearer key, never plaintext cookie secret; expiry index; CAS on version; deletion/tombstone prevents stale request resurrection.

cells.fields: id UUID; user_id; key_digest unique; scopes jsonb; expires_at; revoked_at nullable; last_used_at nullable; auth_version
cells.invariants: Raw secret shown once; FK identity plus current permission checks; purge policy preserves audit metadata without usable credentials.

cells.fields: id UUID; user_id; secret_digest; auth_version; expires_at; used_at nullable; created_at
cells.invariants: Consume under transaction/row lock; single-use; valid only if account auth_version matches; anti-enumeration at response boundary.

cells.fields: id UUID; reset_id FK; ciphertext bytea; nonce; key_id; expires_at; state; lease/fence; attempts; accepted_at nullable
cells.invariants: AEAD-encrypted reset link/recipient; additional data binds reset ID, purpose and expiry. Restricted relay; token + intent atomic. Purge ciphertext at accepted/expired horizon; no raw token in ordinary outbox.

cells.fields: id UUID; scope_hash; action; key_digest; request_digest; response_status; response_headers JSON; response_body JSON; object_key JSON; created_at; expires_at
cells.invariants: Unique(scope_hash,action,key_digest); claim and final response in same mutation transaction; stable response only contains allowed fields. Expiry >= configured client replay window; existing response reauthorized before replay.
cells.record: gogo_idempotency / API and optional Admin operation receipts

cells.fields: id UUID; namespace; exact_key_digests JSON or version_scope; available_at; lease_token; lease_until; attempts; delivered_at nullable
cells.invariants: Business update and invalidation intent same PostgreSQL transaction; Core management relay needs no Async module; atomic target dedupe prevents duplicate version bumps; cleanup after delivered replay horizon.

cells.fields: id UUID; site; actor_id nullable; actor_label snapshot; model label; object key JSON; action; changed_fields JSON; request_id; occurred_at
cells.invariants: Append-only within mutation transaction; sensitive fields excluded; actor deletion SET NULL retains snapshot. Object key snapshot no FK to deleted target. Retention explicit policy.

cells.fields: id UUID; storage_alias; object_key; owner_ref; state enum; content_type; bytes bigint; checksum; created_at; finalized_at nullable
cells.invariants: Unique(storage_alias,object_key); staged/ready/quarantined/deleting/deleted states; private authorization before download; cleanup grace covers transaction rollback/unfinished upload.

cells.fields: id UUID; domain; display_name; active bool
cells.invariants: Unique normalized hostname; request Host already validated; SITE_ID alternative explicit; site content lookup not tenant security by itself.

cells.fields: id UUID; url; title; content; template_name; registration_required bool; site/page join
cells.invariants: Unique(site,url) enforced via scoped mapping; stored content treated as trusted-editor HTML only after sanitization policy; template selection allowlisted.

cells.fields: id UUID; site_id; old_path; new_path; permanent bool
cells.invariants: Unique(site_id,old_path); allowed redirects only; empty target means Gone; prevent cycles and external redirect injection.

cells.fields: id UUID; task_id UUID unique; task_name/version; payload JSON; destination; available_at; state; attempts; lease_token; lease_until; published_at nullable; last_error_code
cells.invariants: Business write and outbox insert same PostgreSQL transaction. SKIP LOCKED relay claims; publish+mark are not atomic; stable task ID and consumer idempotency handle replay; secrets prohibited in payload.

summary: Proposed contract for architecture review; not implemented.
